_meta.description: SentinelMesh KB Master — locked record schema for MITRE ATT&CK technique and CVE records.
_meta.immutability_policy: This schema MUST NOT change in place after Day 1. Any structural change requires a new versioned copy and direct notice to Person 2 (RAG engine) and Person 3 (poisoned-variant generation).

dual_source_routing.note: The multi-stage chain S10 references both sources. Log-tail covers credential/SQLi techniques; Falco covers lateral-movement and privilege-escalation techniques.

id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID. Use dotted sub-technique form where applicable (e.g. T1003.008).

tactic.description: ATT&CK tactic name (Initial Access, Credential Access, Lateral Movement, Defense Evasion, Exfiltration, etc.).

description.description: Factually accurate description of how the technique works. Must not be hallucinated or loosely associated.

detection_signatures.description: Dual-source detection signature. Exactly one or both sub-keys must be non-null, per the dual_source_routing table in _meta.

log_tail.description: Log-tail signature. Present for credential/SQLi techniques (T1190, T1110, T1078, T1212). Null for techniques detected only via Falco.

fields.event_type: string — the JSON event type emitted by the log-tail detector (e.g. login_attempt, jwt_verification)
fields.match_fields: object — key/value pairs that must match in the event for a positive detection
fields.detector_ref: string — filename of the detector script in detection/log-tail/ (e.g. scenario1_detector.py)

falco.description: Falco signature. Present for lateral-movement and privilege-escalation techniques (T1021, T1070, T1003.008, T1041). Null for techniques detected only via log-tail.

fields.rule_name: string — exact Falco rule name as it appears in the YAML rule file
fields.rule_file: string — path to the Falco rule YAML file relative to repo root (e.g. detection/falco-rules/s05_db_access.yaml)
fields.trigger_condition: string — human-readable description of what triggers the rule

related_cves.description: List of CVE IDs directly associated with this technique as exploited in the lab. Empty array [] if no CVE is applicable. CWE references live in the CVE record, not here.

mitigation.description: Factually accurate mitigation guidance drawn from ATT&CK mitigations or CIS benchmarks.

scenario_refs.description: SentinelMesh scenario IDs that exercise this technique (e.g. ["S1", "S10"]). Empty for distractor records.

is_scenario_critical.description: True if this technique is directly used in one of the 9 SentinelMesh scenarios (S1–S10). False for distractor records.

sub_technique_of.description: Parent technique ID for sub-techniques. e.g. T1003 for T1003.008. Null for top-level techniques.

platforms.description: Applicable platforms per ATT&CK. Defaults to ["Linux", "Containers"] for this lab.

data_sources.description: ATT&CK data source components relevant to detecting this technique.

description.description: Accurate, factual description of the vulnerability. Must match NVD/MITRE CVE record — not summarized loosely.

related_technique_ids.description: ATT&CK technique IDs this CVE maps to.

lab_planted.description: True if this CVE is intentionally implanted in the SentinelMesh lab services. False for distractor CVEs.

published_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the CVE was published.

scenario_refs.description: SentinelMesh scenario IDs where this CVE is exercised.

patch_reference.description: URL or package version that resolves the vulnerability.
